verdict.rationale: A probe confirms sift.com/llms.txt serves a real agent-oriented overview document, showing Sift has published llms.txt content an agent could consume. However, the developer docs subdomain (developers.sift.com) returns a 403 on /llms.txt, meaning the more detailed API/tutorial docs are not exposed via the agent-friendly file. Missing for 10: llms.txt or equivalent agent-oriented coverage on the actual API/developer docs subdomain, and no independent/community confirmation of agents successfully using this file.
